pretreatments.description: Biomass conditioning consisting of two rounds of shredding and grinding to reduce particle size, followed by screening to reach a final size of 3 ± 0.5 mm and hydration in a tank.
Biological pretreatment based on the joint action of native microbiota (Clostridium, Lactobacillus, and Enterobacter) of Agave bagasse to hydrolyze xylan into volatile fatty acids.
Enzymatic pretreatment using a commercial enzyme cocktail, Cellulase 50XL, at a dose of 293 endoglucanase units (EGU)/g of bagasse in a 50 mM citrate buffer pH 6.
Dilute acid pretreatment using 1.8 % HCl under soft operating conditions to solubilize xylan and partially cellulose.
Steam explosion pretreatment performed in a plug flow reactor coupled to a flask tank for instant depressurization to solubilize xylan.
Thermal treatment as part of the steam explosion and dilute acid processes (specifically mentioned temperatures such as 116 °C, 152 °C for steam explosion and 100 °C, 119 °C for dilute acid).
